name: DILRMP — Digital India Land Records Modernisation Programme (Cadastral Vector Data)
source: Department of Land Resources (DoLR), Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India (data.gov.in)
date: Varies by state; ongoing digitisation programme
resolution: Vector cadastral polygons; accuracy varies by state and survey vintage
crs: Varies by state (legacy CRS may include Everest 1830, WGS84, local systems); must be verified per state
labels: Parcel boundaries, khasra numbers, land use. No building or 3D data.
license: National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP) / Government of India. Access governed by DILRMP data sharing policy and individual state land record laws.
provenance: Statistical metrics available on data.gov.in. Detailed cadastral GIS vectors available through authorized state-level land record portals (Bhulekh, Dharani, WebLand, etc.).
limitations: ACCESS RESTRICTED — State-level GIS shapefiles require official department clearance. Progress/statistical metrics on data.gov.in do not contain raw parcel polygon geometry. CRS varies by state and may be in legacy datums. Building and height information NOT included.
intended_use: Ground anchor reference: official 2D parcel boundaries and ULPIN linkage for cadastral alignment.
